name: The Strokes

whyMatters.en: New York five-piece formed in 1998. Is This It (2001) and Room on Fire (2003) set compressed garage-pop, interlocking dual guitars, and Julian Casablancas’s half-spoken vocal as a main early-2000s indie reference.
whyMatters.zh: 纽约五人组，1998 年成立。《Is This It》（2001）与《Room on Fire》（2003）以压缩车库流行、交织双吉他，以及 Julian Casablancas 半说唱式人声，成为 2000 年代初 indie 的主要参照。

note.en: From Is This It; short runtime, Stones-like guitar figure, Casablancas vocal fry; major early single.
note.zh: 出自《Is This It》；短时长、偏 Stones 的吉他音型、Casablancas 声带摩擦；早期主要单曲。

note.en: From Room on Fire; interlocking Valensi/Hammond guitar parts, urgent vocal.
note.zh: 出自《Room on Fire》；Valensi/Hammond 交织吉他声部、紧迫人声。

interviewQuotes.text: We just wanted to make cool music.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Julian Casablancas

interviewQuotes.text: The guitars lock like one instrument. That’s the New York part.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Nick Valensi

lyricQuotes: Last night she said, oh baby I don't know

shortBio.en: Casablancas-led NYC indie, 1998–. Last Nite and Reptilia are the main early singles.
shortBio.zh: Casablancas 领衔的纽约 indie，1998 年至今。《Last Nite》与《Reptilia》是早期主要单曲。

body.en:
The Strokes formed in New York in 1998. Is This It (2001, RCA/Rough Trade) and Room on Fire (2003) fixed Casablancas’s half-spoken vocal, interlocking Valensi/Hammond guitars, Fraiture bass, Moretti drums, and a dry, compressed mix.

Last Nite (2001) and Reptilia (2003) are the most-cited singles. The five-piece lineup stayed intact through the debut era. Later albums experiment with longer forms and different production; early citations still center on the first two records.

Julian Casablancas, Nick Valensi, and Fabrizio Moretti met at Dwight School in Manhattan. At 13, Casablancas met guitarist Albert Hammond Jr. at Institut Le Rosey in Switzerland. Nikolai Fraiture completed the five. The name The Strokes dates from 1999. In January 2001 Rough Trade in London issued the three-song Modern Age EP. In March they recorded with Gordon Raphael in the East Village. Is This It came out that summer and reached US #33. The UK #1 that year was Slipknot’s Iowa, not this album. The entry lists The Hives, The Libertines, Arctic Monkeys, Kings of Leon, and The Vines among bands that followed them onto charts. They opened two dates on The Rolling Stones’ 2002 Licks tour. Room on Fire (2003) started with Radiohead producer Nigel Godrich, then went back to Raphael. 12:51 is built on Valensi’s synth-like guitar figure. First Impressions of Earth was their first UK #1. After a long break they reconvened in 2009. Angles (2011) reached US #4 and UK #3. Casablancas recorded his vocals away from the band. Valensi, Chinese-edition wording, said he would not make another album that way.
body.zh:
The Strokes 于 1998 年在纽约成立。《Is This It》（2001，RCA/Rough Trade）与《Room on Fire》（2003）定型 Casablancas 半说唱式人声、Valensi/Hammond 交织吉他、Fraiture 贝斯、Moretti 鼓，以及偏干、压缩的混音。

《Last Nite》（2001）与《Reptilia》（2003）是最常被引用的单曲。出道期五人阵容未变。后期专辑尝试更长曲式与不同制作；引用仍多集中在前两张。

Julian Casablancas、Nick Valensi 与 Fabrizio Moretti 在曼哈顿德怀特学校认识。13 岁时，Casablancas 在瑞士萝实学院认识吉他手 Albert Hammond Jr.。Nikolai Fraiture 补齐五人。The Strokes 这个名字从 1999 年开始。2001 年 1 月，伦敦 Rough Trade 发行三首歌的《Modern Age》EP。3 月他们在东村与 Gordon Raphael 录音。《Is This It》那年夏天发行，美国第 33。当年英国专辑榜首是 Slipknot 的《Iowa》。条目把 The Hives、The Libertines、Arctic Monkeys、Kings of Leon、The Vines 列为随后上榜的乐队。他们给 The Rolling Stones 2002 年《Licks》巡演开了两场。《Room on Fire》（2003）先找了 Radiohead 的制作人 Nigel Godrich，再回到 Raphael。《12:51》建在 Valensi 那条类似合成器的吉他句上。《First Impressions of Earth》是他们第一张英国冠军。长休之后，2009 年重新聚齐。《Angles》（2011）美国第 4、英国第 3。Casablancas 的人声是分开录的。中文版所引 Valensi：下一张要是还这样，他就不做了。

title.zh: nu-metal 电台之后的压缩车库流行

body.en:
Around 2001, US rock radio still carried a lot of nu-metal and polished alternative. The Strokes released short songs with dry production, post-punk guitar chatter, and a NYC downtown image.

Is This It arrived early in that cycle and became a reference point for UK and US indie bands over the next several years.

Rough Trade’s Modern Age EP is the 2001 release. The two Stones support slots are the live node. Libertines, Arctic Monkeys, and Kings of Leon are the UK names in the same paragraph.
body.zh:
2001 年前后，美国摇滚电台仍有大量 nu-metal 与抛光 alternative。The Strokes 推出短歌、干制作、后朋克式吉他碎语，以及纽约市中心形象。

《Is This It》较早进入这一周期，成为此后数年英美 indie 乐队的参照点。

Rough Trade 的《Modern Age》EP 是 2001 年的发行。给 Stones 暖场的两场是现场节点。Libertines、Arctic Monkeys 与 Kings of Leon 写在同一段里。

body.en:
Last Nite uses a Stones-like guitar figure, Casablancas vocal fry, and a tight runtime. It was a main early radio and press entry to Is This It.

The arrangement stays simple: verse/chorus, dual guitar, no extended solos.
body.zh:
《Last Nite》使用偏 Stones 的吉他音型、Casablancas 声带摩擦与紧时长。是《Is This It》早期电台与媒体的重要入口。

编曲保持简单：主副歌、双吉他、无长独奏。

body.en:
Reptilia highlights interlocking guitar parts and a more urgent vocal on Room on Fire.

It shows the band’s writing as arrangement detail—dual guitar lines that fit together—beyond image and dress.
body.zh:
《Reptilia》突出交织吉他声部与《Room on Fire》上更紧迫的人声。

展示乐队写法在编曲细节上——双吉他声部如何咬合——而不只在形象与着装。

body.en:
Early Strokes records pair leather jackets and skinny ties with compressed mixes and short song lengths. Peers copied both the look and the dual-guitar writing.

Later albums add longer forms and different production; citations still lean on Is This It and Room on Fire.
body.zh:
早期 Strokes 唱片把皮衣、瘦领带与压缩混音、短曲长放在一起。同辈常同时模仿外形与双吉他写法。

后期专辑加长曲式与不同制作；引用仍偏向《Is This It》与《Room on Fire》。

body.en:
Early interviews often match the laconic vocal style. They are useful as period press context.

Musical judgment still rests on the singles’ compression, hooks, and dual-guitar parts.
body.zh:
早期访谈常与寡言人声风格一致，可作同期媒体语境。

音乐判断仍看单曲的压缩、钩子与双吉他声部。

note.en: Main early single from Is This It.
Compressed garage-pop and dual-guitar indie on early-2000s charts and press.
note.zh: 压缩车库流行与双吉他 indie，进入 2000 年代初榜单与媒体。

note.en:
Stable five-piece; Is This It and Room on Fire as the citation core.

The five do not change. Godrich is a studio name on the abandoned Room on Fire start, not a member.
note.zh:
稳定五人组；《Is This It》与《Room on Fire》为引用核心。

五人没有换。Godrich 只出现在《Room on Fire》开头没完成的录音室名单里。
